newsitem.title: USA: D&P maintains Goodyear senior debt rating.
newsitem.headline: D&P maintains Goodyear senior debt rating.

text.p: Duff & Phelps Credit Rating Co said Friday it maintains its triple-B-plus senior debt rating on Goodyear Tire & Rubber Co.

D&P said it maintains the rating based on announcements made by Goodyear on February 5 that the company took one-time after-tax charges of $572 million in the 1996 fourth quarter and that its board has approved a three year $600 million stock buyback program.
Goodyear had total outstanding debt of $1.3 billion at 1996 yearend.

D&P said the one-time charges are consistent with its expectations that Goodyear will continue its efforts to improve cost productivity and to shed strategically non-core businesses. Also, the charges will have no material impact on the company's credit protection ratios, it said.
Goodyear's operating performance continues to be good and financial leverage should continue to be modest, D&P said in a statement.
